# The ONE list of the test files CI runs. `bin/test-switchboard` (TestCiTestFileList) derives every `bin/test-*` file from the directory and fails
# a file that is in neither section, a `run` row with no step in .github/workflows/test.yml, and an `exempt` row without a written reason.
# Format, one row per line:
#   run <path>
#   exempt <path> | <why it has no step of its own: at least 20 characters>

exempt bin/test-cloud-launcher.chain | the chain list read by bin/test-cloud-launcher, not a test file
